description: Bends a sheet-metal part along lines the agent drew on one of its planar faces (sketch.create on that face): each line is one bend, so two lines make a U channel in one call. The side of the lines that holds the fixed face's centre stays where it is; the rest turns angle_deg about each line. Folded parts only: a flattened part is refused. Lengths in mm, angles in degrees. Checked before SOLIDWORKS is called: the sketch is lines only, on the fixed face's plane, and the fixed face's centre is on the face and off every line. Checked after: one new bend per line at the angle, inner radius and allowance asked; the volume changed by exactly the bend arithmetic's folded material less what each bend develops to (nothing at K 0.5), wherever a bend's width can be measured; a face of the sheet still lies in the fixed face's plane through its centre, facing the same way; the thickness is unchanged. Otherwise the bend is deleted and the part is as it was (rolled back); the sketch stays. Busy with user_editing while the user is editing a sketch or has a command open. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The part: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

sketch.description: The sketch: its name (Sketch2) or reference. Lines only (construction lines are ignored), on a planar face of the sheet; each line is one bend and may run past the sheet's edges.

fixed_face.description: The planar face of the sheet the sketch is on, by reference (sheetmetal.read gives the base face). The side of the lines holding its centre stays put.

angle_deg.description: How far each bend turns, degrees, more than 0 and less than 180.

bend_radius_mm.description: The bends' inner radius, mm, more than 0. The part's default when absent.

position.description: Where each bend sits relative to its line: bend_outside (the default: the bend starts at the line, on the side that turns), material_inside or material_outside.

flip.description: Bend to the other side of the sheet. Default false.

k_factor.description: The K-factor: where the neutral layer sits across the thickness, more than 0 and at most 1 (0.5 is the middle). The bend develops to angle × (inner radius + K × thickness).

allowance_mm.description: The bend allowance itself, mm, more than 0: the length the bend develops to, whatever its angle.

deduction_mm.description: The bend deduction, mm, 0 or more: what the bend takes off the sum of the two flanges' outer lengths to the virtual sharp.

allowance.description: The bends' own allowance: exactly one of k_factor, allowance_mm or deduction_mm. The part's default when absent.
